
  ▲ vercel flags targeting enable flag [options]

  Enable targeting for a feature flag environment; keeps the current            
  fallthrough unless --default-variant is set                                   

  Options:

       --default-variant <VARIANT>  Replace the fallthrough with this variant   
                                    when no targeting rules match               
  -e,  --environment <ENVIRONMENT>  The environment to enable targeting in      
                                    (production, preview, or development)       
       --message <TEXT>             Optional revision message for the update    
       --project <NAME_OR_ID>       Project name or ID (default: linked project)


  Global Options:

       --cwd <DIR>            Sets the current working directory for a single   
                              run of a command                                  
  -d,  --debug                Debug mode (default: off)                         
  -Q,  --global-config <DIR>  Path to the global `.vercel` directory            
  -h,  --help                 Output usage information                          
  -A,  --local-config <FILE>  Path to the local `vercel.json` file              
       --no-color             No color mode (default: off)                      
       --non-interactive      Run without interactive prompts (default: on when 
                              an agent is detected)                             
  -S,  --scope                Set a custom scope                                
  -t,  --token <TOKEN>        Login token                                       
  -v,  --version              Output the version number                         


  Examples:

  - Enable targeting and keep the current fallthrough

    $ vercel flags targeting enable my-feature --environment production

  - Enable targeting with a static default Off

    $ vercel flags targeting enable my-feature --environment production --default-variant false

  - Enable targeting with a string default

    $ vercel flags targeting enable welcome-message -e production --default-variant control
